description: This PHP source file defines the 'Login' class within the Opencart admin module. The class handles user login functionality, including rendering the login page and processing login requests. It manages session tokens, authentication checks, and navigation redirection based on login status.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: A controller class managing administrator login operations, including rendering the login page, verifying user credentials, session handling, and redirection within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the login page template, initializes session tokens, and checks if the user is already logged in to redirect accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login form submissions, verifies credentials and tokens, manages session data, and redirects upon successful or failed login attempts.
